name: Onboarding Tour page opens from the sidebar and shows the not-indexed empty state
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, opens the Onboarding Tour sidebar item and confirms the route, page header and the empty state the seed produces (the demo repo has no local clone, so the page renders 'Repository not indexed'). Read-only: never clicks Generate or Index repository (no LLM call, no clone/index mutation). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the only repo.
